newsitem.title: USA: Air Products raises alcohol prices.
newsitem.headline: Air Products raises alcohol prices.

text.p: Air Products and Chemicals Inc said Wednesday it will increase prices for its Airvol polyvinyl alcohol, effective September 1, in order to compensate for higher costs for the raw materials.

The company said in a statement it will raise by $0.05 per pound the price for the U.S. adhesives and textile markets, and $100 per metric tonne for Latin America. It said it will also increase by 10 percent the price for Airvol polyvinyl alcohol in Europe. "These increases are necessitated by higher costs for raw materials, principally vinyl acetate monomer, incurred since April," it said.
